selection: Open local candidates with complementary families; no new AMI performance claim or runtime qualification.

models.name: Moshi / Moshiko pinned checkpoint
models.resources: 1 A100 80 GB; language model and Mimi share GPU 0.

models.name: DuplexOmni S1
models.reason: Native speech baseline with S2 disabled.
models.resources: 1 A100 80 GB first; Thinker, Talker, MTP and Code2Wav share GPU 0; historical OOM-only fallback rule stays in force.

models.name: MiniCPM-o 4.5 duplex mode
models.reason: Native duplex baseline; turn-based mode would be labeled separately.
models.resources: 1 A100 80 GB; audio, language and speech components share GPU 0.

models.name: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507
models.reason: Pinned reasoning model for continuity with earlier work.
models.resources: 1 H100 80 GB; weights and KV cache on GPU 0.

models.name: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507
models.reason: Pinned instruction model; pair with Thinking and report output tokens separately.
models.resources: 1 H100 80 GB; weights and KV cache on GPU 0.

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, thinking enabled
models.reason: Recent open-weight model with documented historical-thinking preservation; text input only in this group.
models.resources: 2 H100 80 GB planned; TP2 weights and KV cache across GPUs 0–1.

models.name: Gemma 4 31B IT, thinking enabled
models.reason: Recent independent model family with a native thought channel; this 31B variant is a text candidate, not an audio candidate.
models.resources: 2 H100 80 GB planned; TP2 weights and KV cache across GPUs 0–1.

models.name: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking
models.reason: Audio input with native reasoning and text output.
models.resources: 2 H100 80 GB planned; audio encoder, language weights and KV cache across GPUs 0–1; no Talker.

models.name: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct, text output
models.reason: Audio-input instruction counterpart; disable speech output for the S2 comparison.
models.resources: 2 H100 80 GB planned; Thinker/audio encoder/KV across GPUs 0–1; Talker disabled.

models.name: Step-Audio-R1.1
models.reason: Independent audio-reasoning family; verify extraction of reasoning and answer text before admitting it to the token comparison.
models.resources: 4 H100 80 GB planned, GPUs 0–3 for the vendor vLLM runtime; exact component placement and text-output mode must be qualified.

transcript_tools.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 + Nemotron 3 Diarization
transcript_tools.reason: Reuse pinned English ASR; evaluate the September 2026 diarizer with up to eight speakers.
transcript_tools.causality: Run only on released audio; streaming look-ahead is counted in release time; speaker revisions are versioned.
transcript_tools.resources: 1 L40S 48 GB; ASR and diarization run sequentially on GPU 0.

transcript_tools.name: WhisperX / Whisper large-v3 + pyannote Community-1
transcript_tools.causality: Prefix-only recomputation for this unpaced study; never diarize the full future meeting and backfill labels.
transcript_tools.resources: 1 L40S 48 GB; ASR, alignment and diarization run sequentially on GPU 0; gated model access must be checked.

reviewed_reserves.name: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash
reviewed_reserves.decision: Recent paper checked; no locally runnable open checkpoint and exposed thinking-token path verified in this review, so it is outside the primary matrix.

reviewed_reserves.name: Step-Audio-R1.5
reviewed_reserves.decision: A newer report and benchmarks are linked, while the verified download instructions target R1.1; qualify downloadable R1.5 weights before substitution.

reviewed_reserves.name: Gemma 4 12B IT
reviewed_reserves.decision: Native audio and thinking are documented, but the card limits audio to 30 seconds; reserve for a separately labeled short-audio study.

reviewed_reserves.name: MiniCPM-o 4.5 as S2
reviewed_reserves.decision: Useful reserve candidate; its turn-based audio/reasoning mode and token observability need separate qualification from the S1 duplex path.
